name: RefineURL – Hide login page, Redirect login attempt, Open link in new tab
author: Md Asadullah Galib

sections.description:
RefineURL is a lightweight plugin that allow you to hide login page from any users. You can also drive all the login attempt to specific page of your site. This helps protecting your site from unauthorized login attempt and display a page that you want to promote.

It is a simple yet powerful plugin designed to enhance the security of your website by hiding the login page from unauthorized users.

With its lightweight design, RefineURL prevents direct access to the login page, reducing the risk of brute-force attacks and unauthorized logins.

Easy to set up and configure, it provides an additional layer of security without affecting website performance. Ideal for website administrators looking for a seamless way to protect their login page.

Features List

  • Hide Login Page – With a single click settings, you can hide the WordPress login page of your website. This will not change the core file in the site. But this save a hundreds of attacks and unauthorized login attempt.
  • Redirect Login attempt – You can redirect all the login attempt to a specific page. This way, you can display a specific page, error page or special offer page repeatedly to your potential audience.

Important Note: If you hide your login page with RefineURL and logout from your site, you won’t access the login page from wp-admin or wp-login.php. Because all logout users will be prevented from login page. In that case, you can login to your website from hosting panel.

Open link into new tab is one of the easy feature to improve user experience in any website. We have added this features for you in this plugin.

  • Open Internal link in New Tab – You can setup all the internal link open in new tab. You can save it once and all of your internal link will open in new tab automatically.

  • Open External Link In New Tab – You can setup all the external link in a new tab too. Setup from the RefineURL settings and enjoy the features. This settings option available in the settings page.

  • All internal link do follow and no follow option: You can set all the internal link as either do-follow links or no-follow links. No more manual link update needed.

  • All external link do follow and no follow option: Similar to internal link, you can set all external link as either do-follow or no follow links. Specially, for external links, no-follow links are important to protect link juice on the website.

  • User redirection after login – Now you can redirect users into a specific page after login to the site. This features help you to promote a specific page.

  • User redirection after logout

  • User redirection after registration

  • RefineURL Pro is under development. You can subscribe today to get the notification first.

  • New layout for support and resource page
  • Options to change login URL into specific page
  • Generate temporary login URL that allow login without password

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your ‘wp-content/plugins’ directory, or download and install automatically through your admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How to get started with RefineURL?

In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to RefineURL > Settings to get started.
